requirements.title: Publication contents are safe to share

criteria.assertion: The current publication tree and complete reachable Git history pass the pinned credential-pattern scanner with no unresolved scanner findings.
criteria.procedure: Run the maintained current-tree and all-history secret audit; retain its current-source receipt, complete ref fingerprint, pinned scanner version and named check results. Finding resolution and any required credential rotation are reviewed under PUB-01.02.

criteria.assertion: Publication files, historical findings, screenshots, fixtures, dependencies, fonts, and brand assets have been reviewed for private information and redistribution rights; findings are resolved, exposed credentials rotated, and required notices present.
criteria.procedure: Record a publication and provenance review, including unresolved ownership or privacy findings and license/notice decisions. Do not put secrets, private backlog content, or raw scan findings in public artifacts.

requirements.title: Installer configuration is independent of the maintainer instance

criteria.assertion: The public installation configuration, installation script, and configuration guide exist and are nonempty.
criteria.procedure: Check the existence of maintained installer files. Independence and safe defaults are exercised in PUB-02.02.

criteria.assertion: A generated installation plan uses installer-owned identities and resources; secrets are separate from public values, and unconfigured forks skip deployment and health workflows clearly.
criteria.procedure: Retain plan-validation and workflow-safety results, including negative cases for maintainer-resource references, missing configuration, and accidentally enabled fixture authentication.

requirements.title: Public claims accurately describe the implemented release

criteria.assertion: README, current specification, installation guides, and capability statements agree on implemented, experimental, and planned behavior; each advertised behavioral promise has applicable evidence.
criteria.procedure: Review claims against the product scenarios for this source. Confirm agent claims have working examples, local evaluation is distinguished from hosted operation, and specification changes follow versioning policy.

requirements.title: A clean local evaluation has a supported persistent lifecycle

criteria.assertion: The local quickstart, pinned container configuration, and lifecycle rehearsal procedure exist and are nonempty.
criteria.procedure: Check the maintained installation and rehearsal files; execute RUN-01.02 for usability and persistence proof.

criteria.assertion: A clean checkout starts using documented prerequisites, initializes repeatably, supports issue creation/editing, and retains issue identity and content through stop/restart and container replacement with documented storage preserved. Deliberate reset is verified separately.
criteria.procedure: Run scripts/check-local-install.sh against an isolated checkout. Retain setup and assertion receipts for initialization, issue operations, restart, replacement, and deliberate reset. Record host/container runtime identity and the exact source fingerprint.

criteria.assertion: An unfamiliar evaluator can follow local setup, understand synthetic identity and localhost boundaries, find storage/reset instructions, and recover from documented common setup failures.
criteria.procedure: Record newcomer evaluation findings and their resolution. Automated execution does not establish instruction clarity.

requirements.title: Cloudflare installation succeeds with isolated installer resources

criteria.assertion: From the published source repository, the documented button/setup procedure provisions a fresh installation with a dedicated Worker, D1 database, private R2 bucket, Durable Object namespaces, separate origin and installer workspace identity; native sign-in, issue creation, member admission/removal and persistence succeed, and setup retries preserve data. A rehearsal in the owner's existing authorized Cloudflare account explicitly records shared account/provider dependencies and does not establish separate-account onboarding.
criteria.procedure: Exercise the official deployment-button and documented setup flow using fresh dedicated resources and a separate origin in an account explicitly authorized for rehearsal. Record source/deployed version, Worker/D1/R2/DO identities, new workspace state, resource separation from the maintainer pilot, and whether the account, sender or provider credentials are shared. Retain actual owner/member mail, admission, removal, issue persistence, redeployment/retry, anonymous denial and disabled fixture-identity observations. Record manual provider steps and existing account entitlement/permission assumptions; same-account resource isolation does not prove account creation, billing eligibility or cross-account onboarding.

criteria.assertion: GitHub integration is optional for installation and can be configured separately with an installer-owned App; required permissions, callbacks, and recovery steps work as documented.
criteria.procedure: Verify core use with no GitHub credentials; connect a separate installer-owned App to selected disposable repositories, exercise linking and revocation/reconnection, and retain sanitized observations.

requirements.title: Operators can upgrade, recover, and remove their installation

criteria.assertion: A candidate installation containing representative directory, issue, discussion, collaborative-body and branch data can be backed up and restored into an isolated target with the documented access recovery behavior. Every declared supported upgrade baseline passes a populated-data upgrade exercise; an initial release without a prior supported baseline explicitly documents that boundary.
criteria.procedure: Record the candidate source, populated fixture, destination isolation and restored-data/access assertions. Preserve corruption and nonempty-target rejection proof. Exercise each declared supported upgrade path with populated data; for an initial release with no prior supported baseline, record that documented applicability decision without claiming upgrade compatibility. A fresh empty database does not establish upgrade compatibility.

criteria.assertion: Operating guidance explains services/plans, dated cost assumptions, storage responsibilities, health checks, backup coverage/retention, upgrade and rollback limits, credential rotation, export limitations, and data-preserving teardown.
criteria.procedure: Review each operating responsibility against the implemented system and provider documentation. Validate teardown only on disposable resources; identify unsupported portability or export promises.

requirements.title: The README supports evaluation and adoption

criteria.assertion: Supported documentation links, assets, package commands, workspace inventory, metadata, and changelog structure pass the maintained mechanical documentation checks.
criteria.procedure: Execute the existing documentation checker. This checks mechanical contracts and does not establish prose accuracy or tone.

criteria.assertion: README writing rules pass; its product description, screenshot, maturity, limitations, setup choices, prerequisites and help are current, clear, friendly and business-like, without sales language, hedging or intentional contrastive framing.
criteria.procedure: Review the resulting text and synthetic screenshot against the current app. Record editorial findings and resolutions; passing DOC-01.03 writing checks is only part of this review.

criteria.assertion: README, evaluation guide and case-study prose pass the pinned project writing rules.
criteria.procedure: Run the maintained prose audit and retain the current-source receipt showing the pinned Vale version and passing writing-rules check. Editorial judgment remains DOC-01.02.

requirements.title: Security, support, and contribution expectations are explicit

criteria.assertion: Security, support and contribution policies and issue/PR templates exist and are nonempty.
criteria.procedure: Check maintained policy/template files. Review actual commitments and settings under GOV-01.02.

criteria.assertion: Private vulnerability reporting works, supported versions and maintenance expectations are realistic, contribution commands are accurate, and actual repository rules require the intended checks.
criteria.procedure: Retain applicable individual Scorecard findings and read-only GitHub repository-setting evidence. Confirm private reporting and required verifier/changelog/spec-lock checks in actual rules. Missing settings permissions remain blocked; policy files alone do not prove enforcement.

requirements.title: Paid implementation help has a concrete scope

criteria.assertion: A visible professional contact route describes deployment, authentication, optional integrations, backup verification and handover, with customer prerequisites and deliverables; initial setup and ongoing maintenance are separately described.
criteria.procedure: Review the offer as a prospective engineering manager and confirm that all commitments can be delivered. Link checks establish route syntax; service suitability is an explicit human judgment.

requirements.title: Portfolio material represents the engineering accurately

criteria.assertion: A maintained case study exists and is nonempty.
criteria.procedure: Check the case-study artifact; evaluate attribution, walkthrough, and evidence under PORT-01.02.

criteria.assertion: Case study and synthetic walkthrough explain the problem, author's role, decisions, tradeoffs and implemented scope; technical claims have evidence and performance measurements identify source, environment, and workload.
criteria.procedure: Review attribution and each technical claim against applicable evidence. Complete before portfolio promotion. Do not describe synthetic seed measurements as real-team production observations.

requirements.title: The published release matches its qualified evidence

criteria.assertion: The complete devcontainer verifier passes for the exact current source, with every required step executed and retained logs bound to the supplied evidence.
criteria.procedure: Run ./scripts/devcontainer.sh verify, then supply the full all-profile receipt and SHA-256-bound command logs. Doctor, partial, failed, skipped, stale and incomplete receipts cannot satisfy this criterion.

criteria.assertion: History-aware changelog and spec-lock checks pass, independent installation evidence applies to the candidate, release notes state limitations, and the published tag resolves to the qualified source.
criteria.procedure: Retain separate PR-base-aware check receipts, a candidate/tag identity record and release notes. Review applicability of all evidence before publication; creating a checklist or merging a PR does not establish a tagged release.
